summary: Mandate Shareable Links Feature - Complete Testing. All backend tests passed (16/16). Frontend UI verified for Employer Jobs, Admin Jobs, and MandateApplyPage. Feature allows employers/admin to generate secure shareable links for assigned mandates independent of career page visibility.
passed_tests: ✅ PUT /api/jobs/{job_id}/mandate-shareable-link - Admin can enable mandate link
✅ PUT /api/jobs/{job_id}/mandate-shareable-link - Employer can enable mandate link
✅ GET /api/public/mandate/{job_id}?token={token} - Returns job details with valid token
✅ POST /api/public/apply with mandate_token - Application accepted via mandate link
✅ POST /api/public/apply with invalid mandate_token - Falls back to career page or rejects
✅ Job response includes mandate_shareable_link_enabled and mandate_share_token fields
✅ Recruiter cannot enable mandate shareable links (403/404)
✅ Unauthenticated users cannot enable mandate links (401/403)
✅ Application channel tracking works for mandate link applications
✅ FRONTEND: Employer Jobs page shows 'Mandate Link' toggle for active jobs
✅ FRONTEND: Admin Jobs page shows 'Mandate' toggle for active jobs
✅ FRONTEND: MandateApplyPage displays job details with 'Private Listing' badge
✅ FRONTEND: MandateApplyPage shows application form with all required fields
✅ FRONTEND: MandateApplyPage shows 'Access Denied' for invalid/expired tokens
critical_code_review_comments: Token regeneration on enable/disable: Each time mandate link is enabled, a new token is generated. This is secure but means old links become invalid.
Dual access path: Public apply endpoint correctly tries mandate link first, then falls back to career page access
Role-based access control: Only admin and employer can enable mandate links, recruiters are correctly denied
Privacy preserved: Company name shows as 'Confidential Client' on mandate apply page

mocked_apis.note: Email and WhatsApp notifications are MOCKED

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing job data
